sources.dateOrElection: 2026 General Election, official electorate candidates after nomination close
limitations: Supplied unchanged by James (project owner), who downloaded it from the Electoral Commission's official 2026 general election publication after nominations closed (12:00 NZDT, 8 October 2026). The exact download URL was not recorded; elections.nz blocks automated retrieval (bot protection), and a bounded search on 2026-10-09 found no stable asset URL. The url field records the publishing host only.
retrievedAt is when the file reached the project (upload time); James's download was no later than this.
One sheet 'Candidates' (Name, Electorate, Party), 469 rows. Names are 'SURNAME, Given' as published. 'Party' is the affiliation as published, including 11 unregistered party names and 'Independent'.
sources.licence: Publisher copyright; preserved for evidence and attributed research; no licence assumed.
